## Outline

- Ratings and the utility matrix
- Holding out observed ratings and evaluating with RMSE
- Global-average baseline and similar-user KNN
- Content-based recommendation with per-user regression
- New items, new users, and feature limitations
- Ranking, diversity, exploration, and feedback

## Class demo

[Download the recommender systems notebook](slides/demos/lecture-16-recommender-systems.ipynb)

The notebook uses [toy ratings](slides/data/toy_ratings.csv) and [movie features](slides/data/toy_movie_feats.csv). Keep the notebook in a `demos/` folder next to a `data/` folder containing both CSVs.
